latestMessage.title: GNAAS Congress 2026
latestMessage.body:
One Week.🌝 One Purpose.🪢 One Flame🔥

Be present to witness this year's GNAAS Congress. Sept. 20-27 | St. Monica's College, Asante Mampong. Register Now🤗: http://congress.gnaas.org ©️GNAAS NATIONAL 2026
